## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run test` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] New behavior has tests covering valid input, malformed input, and important edge cases
- [ ] I did not add fake ratings, reviews, or fabricated claims (per docs/content.md)
- [ ] New indexable pages have a unique `<title>`, meta description, canonical, and H1
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` values are committed
- [ ] I did not add `innerHTML`, `eval`, an unreviewed remote script, or a hidden network upload
- [ ] New tools remain `draft`/non-indexable unless this PR includes explicit publication-review evidence
- [ ] Security inspection tools clearly distinguish decoding/inspection from verification
